title: 7-3 Microprogram Example
text: Once the configuration of a computer and its microprogrammed control unit is established, the designer's task is to generate the microcode for the control memory. This code generation is called microprogramming and is a process similar to conventional machine language programming. To appreciate this process, we present here a simple digital computer and show how it is microprogrammed. The computer used here is similar but not identical to the basic computer introduced in Chap. 5.
